name: zclass_sound_render_traverse
description: zClass_Sound::RenderTraverse renders visible sound nodes with saved-parent transform context.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for sound render traversal; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass render traversal source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja/source review validates visible-flag gating, transform-dirty clearing, cull result propagation, bounds-context push/pop, matrix push/apply/pop, render callback, and child dispatch.
